name: canvy
description: Make editable hand-drawn diagrams in Thai and English from a short description.
long_description: Ask Claude for a flowchart, process, architecture or org chart and get a Canvy link that opens it as an editable hand-drawn diagram. Works in Thai and English, accepts Mermaid, and stores nothing: the diagram travels inside the link and is saved only in your browser when you open it.

tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Create an editable Canvy diagram link from Canvy syntax or Mermaid
